title: arrangement.copy
description: Copies clips, as pasting copied clips (mode window) and duplicating clips (mode full) do in OpenTune. Every copy is a new clip with a new content: with mode window the content holds only the part of the source content that the clip shows, with its notes, pitch curve and time grid in that part; with mode full it is a complete copy of the source content, and the copy shows the same part of it. Copies keep the gain and the fades of their sources. They go to track toTrackId: the copy of the earliest source starts at startTimelineSec and the others keep their distances from it. A copy that starts where its source starts plays together with it (warning STACKED_ON_SOURCE), a copy that overlaps another clip carries the warning OVERLAPS_CLIP, and copying onto a hidden track shows it (sideEffects.tracksRevealed {trackIds, revert: null}, warning TRACK_AUTO_REVEALED). expectedArrangementRevision guards against concurrent changes (REVISION_CONFLICT(arrangement_changed)); a source that does not exist, or a toTrackId that names no track slot, gives NOT_FOUND(unknown_handle). created lists the new placements and contents, and idMap relates every source to its copy (relation copy). As in OpenTune there is no undo entry: the undo reason is ui_parity, and the revert recipe removes the copies with arrangement.edit, op delete, which needs the end user's consent, so the recipe carries requiresConsent true (PROTOCOL.md section 15.2 rule 4).
